topic: Visualizing Complex Roots: From Equations to Domain Coloring

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Complex Plane
lecture_lines: Complex numbers are points in a 2D plane.
Functions map inputs to new output points.
Observe the rubber sheet transformation. [Asset: grid_transform]

sections.title: The Winding Number: Counting Roots
lecture_lines: A contour wraps around the origin.
The winding number counts net wraps.
Wrapped loops identify trapped roots. [Asset: fishing_net]
animations: Show closed curve in #00FF00 around origin using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/net.svg] to visualize the net path.

sections.title: Numerical Root-Finding: Newton’s Method
lecture_lines: Derivatives guide us toward the target.
The scout reaches the valley. [Asset: robot_scout]
animations: Render function output #FFFFFF as blue point using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg].

sections.title: Domain Coloring: Visualizing 4D
lecture_lines: Color denotes phase, brightness denotes magnitude.
Zeros appear as complete color wheels.
This visualizes four dimensions easily. [Asset: color_map]
animations: Map 2D complex plane to color field #FF00FF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg].
Animate hue rotation based on phase #00FFFF.
Show brightness variation representing magnitude #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lightbulb.svg].

sections.title: Synthesis: The 'Root Finder' Dashboard
lecture_lines: Scan with colors, verify with loops.
The dashboard locates roots precisely. [Asset: detector_dashboard]
animations: Sync domain coloring view #FF00FF with roots.
